info.name: HustleHub+ Part 3 - Final PoE
info.description: Live API checks for the final PoE. Run against an isolated MongoDB database (the CI pipeline runs it against the Docker Compose stack). Limit probes deliberately exhaust the per-IP budgets and must reach 429, so wait 15 minutes or restart the API before another run. Set ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD (an account made with scripts/seedAdmin.js) to also run the admin checks; without them those requests are skipped. This collection creates unique fictional users.

item.name: Second Freelancer Cannot Update First's Gig (expect 403 Ownership)
Freelancer Cannot Book a Gig (expect 403 RBAC)

exec: pm.test('Transaction belongs to the booking', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.transaction.bookingId).to.eql(d.booking.id); pm.expect(d.transaction.freelancerId).to.eql(d.booking.freelancerId); pm.expect(d.transaction.clientId).to.eql(d.booking.clientId); });

item.name: Client Cannot List Bookings Received (expect 403 RBAC)
Booking Identity And Price Tampering Rejected
Second Freelancer Has No Received Bookings

exec: pm.test('Income matches this isolated freelancer exactly', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.totalIncome).to.eql(1750));

item.name: Client Cannot Access Income Summary (expect 403 RBAC)
Second Freelancer Cannot Delete First's Gig (expect 403)

exec: pm.test('Booked price and title stay saved', () => { const b = pm.response.json().data.bookings.find(b => b.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('bookingId')); pm.expect(b.priceAtBooking).to.eql(1750); pm.expect(b.gigTitle).to.eql('Logo Design'); });

item.name: 6. Part 3 Security Features (Lockout, Logout, Admin RBAC, Analytics)
Client Cannot Read Admin Overview (expect 403 RBAC)
Freelancer Cannot Read Admin Users (expect 403 RBAC)
Admin Security Events Need A Token (expect 401)

exec: pm.test('Tax breakdown adds up to the estimate', () => pm.expect(s.taxBreakdown.netTax).to.eql(s.estimatedAnnualTax));
pm.test('Net income is income minus tax', () => pm.expect(s.netIncomeAfterTax).to.eql(Math.round((s.taxYearIncome - s.estimatedAnnualTax) * 100) / 100));

item.name: Lockout: Five Wrong Passwords Are Refused (expect 401)

exec: pm.test('Wrong password rejected (' + n + ' of 5)', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));

item.name: Lockout: Correct Password Is Now Blocked (expect 429 + Retry-After)

exec: pm.test('Message says the account is locked', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('temporarily locked'));
pm.test('No password hashes or security counters', () => pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.match(/passwordHash|tokenVersion|failedLoginAttempts|\$2[aby]\$/));

pm.test('Locked victim is flagged', () => { const row = pm.response.json().data.users.find(u => u.email === pm.collectionVariables.get('lockoutEmail').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(row && row.locked).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Admin: Security Events Show The Lockout (expect 200)

exec: pm.test('account_locked event was logged', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => e.event === 'account_locked')).to.eql(true));
pm.test('login_failed events were logged', () => pm.expect(events.some(e => e.event === 'login_failed')).to.eql(true));
pm.test('Clear limit message', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Too many booking attempts'));
pm.test('Unavailable probe gig is rejected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('Every response carries a request ID', () => pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-Id')).to.match(/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/));
